families.name: Agriculture
families.description: Farming, agricultural cooperatives and consortia, agricultural contracting and livestock organisations.
families.criteria: The employer grows crops or raises livestock, or serves farms directly.

families.name: Food and tobacco
families.description: Food industry, bakeries and first processing of tobacco leaf.
families.criteria: The employer processes food or agricultural products for consumption.

families.name: Insurance
families.description: Insurance companies.
families.criteria: The employer is an insurance company.

families.name: Land reclamation and forestry
families.description: Land reclamation and irrigation consortia, hydraulic and forestry works.
families.criteria: The employer maintains land, waterways and forests.

families.name: Paper, printing and publishing
families.description: Paper and board manufacturing, printing, publishing and graphic communication.
families.criteria: The employer makes paper or prints and publishes.

families.name: Chemicals, rubber, glass and ceramics
families.description: Chemical, pharmaceutical, rubber and plastics, glass and ceramics industries.
families.criteria: The employer transforms materials through chemical or high-temperature processes.

families.name: Commerce and distribution
families.description: Wholesale and retail trade of goods, including cooperative and import-export distribution.
families.criteria: The employer buys and sells goods; the agreement is signed by a trade association.

families.name: Banking
families.description: Banks and cooperative credit banks.
families.criteria: The employer is a bank.

families.name: Public administration, managers
families.description: Managers of the public administration bargaining areas negotiated by ARAN.
families.criteria: The employer is a public administration and the staff are managers or health executives.

families.name: Construction
families.description: Building and civil engineering, whatever the size or legal form of the employer.
families.criteria: The employer builds, renovates or maintains buildings and civil works and enrols in a Cassa Edile.

families.name: Energy and public utilities
families.description: Oil and energy, electricity, gas and water, waste and environmental services.
families.criteria: The employer produces or distributes energy or water, or runs environmental public services.

families.name: Pharmacies
families.description: Private and municipal pharmacies.
families.criteria: The employer runs a community pharmacy.

families.name: Police forces
families.description: Police forces with a civil status, under a public-law regime negotiated outside ARAN.
families.criteria: The staff belong to a police force whose pay is set by public-law agreements (D.Lgs. 195/1995).

families.name: Telecommunications and IT
families.description: Telecommunications operators and IT services companies.
families.criteria: The employer runs networks or builds and operates software and IT services.

families.name: Private education and training
families.description: Private schools and vocational training bodies.
families.criteria: The employer teaches or trains outside the public administration.

families.name: Domestic work
families.description: Domestic workers and carers employed by households.
families.criteria: The employer is a household, not a business.

families.name: Wood and furniture
families.description: Wood working and furniture manufacturing.
families.criteria: The employer works wood or makes furniture.

families.name: Building materials and extraction
families.description: Cement, lime, plaster, bricks, stone and quarrying, mining.
families.criteria: The employer extracts minerals or produces building materials from them.

families.name: Metalworking
families.description: Metalworking, engineering and plant installation, including jewellery and goldsmith manufacturing.
families.criteria: The employer works metals or builds machines and installations, whatever its size or legal form.

families.name: Associations and trade unions
families.description: Staff of trade unions and representative associations.
families.criteria: The employer is an association representing workers or businesses.

families.name: Leather and footwear
families.description: Tanning, leather goods and footwear manufacturing.
families.criteria: The employer tans hides or makes leather goods or footwear.

families.name: Public administration, non-managerial staff
families.description: Non-managerial staff of the public administration bargaining sectors negotiated by ARAN.
families.criteria: The employer is a public administration under D.Lgs. 165/2001 and the staff are not managers.

families.name: Cleaning and integrated services
families.description: Cleaning, sanitation, integrated facility services and industrial laundries.
families.criteria: The employer cleans, sanitises or maintains premises and textiles of other businesses.

families.name: Motoring services
families.description: Driving schools, motoring consultancy, garages and vehicle rental.
families.criteria: The employer provides services to motorists, not passenger or goods transport.

families.name: Real estate and building management
families.description: Real estate brokerage, building caretaking and public housing bodies.
families.criteria: The employer brokers, manages or keeps residential buildings.

families.name: Personal care services
families.description: Hairdressing and beauty.
families.criteria: The employer provides personal care services to consumers.

families.name: Postal services
families.description: Universal postal service, mail delivery and courier services.
families.criteria: The employer collects and delivers mail or parcels.

families.name: Professional and business services
families.description: Professional offices and data-processing service centres.
families.criteria: The employer sells intellectual or administrative services to businesses or professionals.

families.name: Private health and social care
families.description: Private hospitals, nursing homes and social-care institutions, including social cooperatives.
families.criteria: The employer delivers health, care or social-assistance services.

families.name: Entertainment and broadcasting
families.description: Film production, cinemas and radio and television broadcasting.
families.criteria: The employer produces, distributes or shows audiovisual content.

families.name: Sport facilities
families.description: Sport facilities, gyms and sport associations.
families.criteria: The employer runs sport facilities or organises sport activities.

families.name: Textiles and fashion
families.description: Textile, clothing and fashion accessories manufacturing, including eyewear.
families.criteria: The employer manufactures textiles, clothing or fashion accessories.

families.name: Transport, logistics and transport infrastructure
families.description: Goods and passenger transport by road, rail, sea, air and cable, logistics, shipping agencies and road infrastructure operators.
families.criteria: The employer moves goods or people, or operates the infrastructure they travel on.

families.name: Tourism and hospitality
families.description: Hotels, campsites, restaurants and bars, collective catering, spas and travel agencies.
families.criteria: The employer hosts, feeds or organises the travel of customers.

families.name: Private security
families.description: Armed private security guards and unarmed fiduciary services.
families.criteria: The employer provides guarding, surveillance or fiduciary security services.
